output:
I'll start by reading the docs and looking at the data layout.

Output was truncated; I'll read the middle files separately.

I wrote `/app/bin/crosstabs.py` and ran it on `/app/data`. The result is saved at `/app/out/tables.json`. The script uses only the standard library.

- **Unit tests:** `python -m unittest discover -s tests -t .` ran 4 tests and all passed.
- **Approved tables:** `python tools/check_tables.py` reported "OK: every figure matches the approved tables", for the summary and all six tables.

I followed the rules in `/app/docs` rather than anything specific to the current files, so other surveys should run the same way. I only tested it on the current survey and the four small test surveys.

I also wrote `/app/STATUS.json` with status `success`. I didn't touch `/app/data`, `/app/docs`, `/app/tests` or `/app/tools`.

I wrote /app/bin/crosstabs.py and ran it on /app/data. The result is saved at /app/out/tables.json. The script uses only the standard library.

- Unit tests: python -m unittest discover -s tests -t . ran 4 tests and all passed.
- Approved tables: python tools/check_tables.py reported "OK: every figure matches the approved tables", for the summary and all six tables.

I followed the rules in /app/docs rather than anything specific to the current files, so other surveys should run the same way. I only tested it on the current survey and the four small test surveys.

I also wrote /app/STATUS.json with status success. I didn't touch /app/data, /app/docs, /app/tests or /app/tools.

command_result.command: cd /app; find . -path ./.git -prune -o -type f -print | head -100; cat docs/overview.md; wc -c docs/*
cd /app/docs; cat exports.md codebook.md cleaning.md weighting.md tables.md output.md changelog.md
cd /app/docs; sed -n '/^## 5. Routing/,$p' codebook.md; cat cleaning.md weighting.md

cd /app; cat data/codebook.json | head -150; cat data/weighting.json data/tables.json data/exports/export_log.txt; head -c 600 data/exports/*.csv; cat tools/check_tables.py | head -60; sed -n 1,60p tests/test_tables.py; ls bin out; python3 --version

cd /app; python3 - <<'E'
import json
c=json.load(open('data/codebook.json'))
for q in c['questions'][2:]:
    print(json.dumps(q))
E
cd /app; python3 bin/crosstabs.py data out/tables.json && python -m unittest discover -s tests -t . 2>&1 | tail -30; python tools/check_tables.py | tail -40

cd /app; echo '{"status":"success","summary":"Wrote /app/bin/crosstabs.py following the documented rules (exports, routing, cleaning, raking/trimming, weighted crosstabs) and ran it on /app/data to produce /app/out/tables.json. The unit tests pass and tools/check_tables.py reports every figure matches."}' > STATUS.json; git status --short 2>&1 | head
